correctness.rationale: For M>=2l+1, Fourier orthogonality proves each azimuthal block is a 2x2 helicity matrix with determinant a²-m²b²; the zonal derivative and Jacobi factors give the exact forbidden set, whose root count is l²−1 with multiplicity. At degree two, normalized associated-Legendre functions yield the five double spectral levels. Elementary factorizations prove that max/min on 0<t<1/2 is q2+/min(q0,q1−), with one cubic crossing; outside, q2+/q2− gives a strictly worse lower bound. Independently constructed full complex point-evaluation matrices verify every predicted singular value at eleven heights, rank losses at 0,±1/2, Jacobi identities to degree ten, and parity through degree eight. Bounded tests corroborate, but do not replace, the analytic proof.
